draw.tools.lasso.note: U:prism/draw: PowerPoint's Lasso Select: a loop drawn freehand selects the objects whose centre is inside it and the ink with a point inside it (deckcraft's Select button only carries the lasso icon; not checked against upstream).

draw.convert.ink-to-text.note: U:prism/draw: hidden: deckcraft's Ink to Text is a disabled "coming soon" button; there is no handwriting recognizer.

draw.convert.ink-to-math.note: U:prism/draw: hidden: deckcraft's Ink to Math is a disabled "coming soon" button; there is no math recognizer.

draw.replay.ink-replay.note: U:prism/draw: hidden: deckcraft does not keep when each stroke was drawn, so there is nothing to replay.
